name: DIGITAL GRID Corporation
summary: DIGITAL GRID Corporation operates a power trading platform in Japan through Electricity PF, Renewable energy PF and Other segments. Its offerings include Digital Grid Platform for procuring electricity, Econohashi for purchasing environmental value, RE Bridge, an auction site for virtual PPAs, battery aggregation and GX Navi, a decarbonization training service. It also runs balancing power and decarbonization education businesses. Dating from 2017, it has its base in Minato, Japan.
